summary: ToString is identity for JavaScript String values.

semantics.encoding: ECMAScript strings are UTF-16 code-unit sequences, matching .NET string storage model closely

tests.name: lone surrogate preserved
tests.expected_behavior: returns a one-code-unit string containing the lone surrogate

caveats: Do not assume Unicode scalar-value normalization; lone surrogates are valid JavaScript string code units and must be preserved.
references: ECMAScript Language Specification, Type Conversion abstract operations (living specification)
